name: vodka sauce
instructions:
A DIFFERENT BRANCH of the tomato-sauce family — this one adds heavy cream. Structurally it belongs somewhere between the pure-tomato family and a cream sauce. It's grouped with the italian-tomato-sauces siblings because the sauce is fundamentally a tomato dish that happens to add cream, not a cream dish that happens to add tomato. Gigi Hadid style.

See sibling recipes in the italian-tomato-sauces folder ([[marcella-tomato-sauce]], [[sicilian-pesto-rosso]], [[pasta-piperade]], [[marcella-eggplant-sauce]]) for other italian tomato-sauce shapes.

=== INGREDIENTS ===

- 1 medium yellow onion, finely chopped
- 3-4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2-3 tablespoons butter
- 2-3 tablespoons olive oil
- 4-6 tablespoons tomato paste (concentrated)
- 1/4 cup vodka
- 1/2 to 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream
- red chili flakes (canonical here — the gigi hadid version leans on them)
- grated parmesan cheese
- fresh basil (torn, off heat)
- salt to taste
- pasta (short shapes — penne, rigatoni)

=== PROCEDURE ===

1. Sauté onion and garlic in butter + olive oil until softened.
2. Add tomato paste and cook it hard in the fat until it darkens a shade and smells sweet-caramelized (~3-5 min). This is the load-bearing flavor step.
3. Pour in vodka; let it reduce briefly (~2 min).
4. Stir in heavy cream and red chili flakes. Simmer to combine.
5. Off heat, fold in grated parmesan and torn fresh basil. Salt to taste.
6. Toss with cooked short pasta.
notes:
The vodka sauce outlier of the italian-tomato-sauces family. Split out from the former italian-tomato-sauces.json (Variant C) into its own file. Gigi Hadid-style version — heavy on the chili flakes.

=== SITS ON A DIFFERENT BRANCH FROM THE OTHER TOMATO SAUCES ===

Vodka sauce is the outlier in the family. [[marcella-tomato-sauce]] and [[sicilian-pesto-rosso]] stay on the pure-tomato axis (with almonds+cheese carrying fat load in the pesto rosso); this one adds heavy cream and moves the sauce toward a cross-family space between italian tomato and cream sauces. That's why it's called 'a different branch.' It still belongs in the folder because the tomato paste + tomato register is doing the flavor work — this is a tomato sauce that happens to add cream, not a cream sauce that happens to add tomato.

=== TOMATO PASTE IS THE TOMATO SOURCE — LOAD-BEARING ===

Uses tomato PASTE cooked hard in the fat until it darkens as the main tomato base. This is opposite of [[marcella-tomato-sauce]] and [[sicilian-pesto-rosso]] (which want canned whole tomatoes or sun-dried respectively). Paste is structural here.

=== COOK THE TOMATO PASTE HARD IN THE FAT ===

The darken-and-caramelize step (~3-5 min) is where the flavor comes from. Under-cook it and the sauce tastes tinny and raw. Cook it until it visibly darkens a shade and smells sweet-caramelized.

=== RED CHILI FLAKES CANONICAL ===

The gigi hadid version leans on chili flakes. Not optional here (unlike the sicilian pesto rosso where they're optional). Adjust to taste but include them.

=== SHORT PASTA — PENNE OR RIGATONI ===

The thick creamy sauce needs ridged short shapes to grip. Long strands slide out from under it.

=== FRESH BASIL AT THE END ===

Torn fresh basil folded in off heat. Same rule as most italian cream/tomato dishes — basil wilts fast and turns brown if you cook it.

=== SIBLING RECIPES (TOMATO PASTA SAUCE TAG) ===

- [[marcella-tomato-sauce]]: 3-ingredient tomato + butter + onion simmered.
- [[sicilian-pesto-rosso]]: raw blended sun-dried-tomato + almond pesto.
- [[pasta-piperade]]: blended vegetable-tomato base.
- [[marcella-eggplant-sauce]]: fried eggplant folded into a garlic-tomato base.
original_chef: Gigi Hadid style. Not one specific author (viral home-cook version of a standard italian-american vodka sauce).
